Audit repo /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-55_global-footer-ui, 55 commits ahead of develop.

YOUR SCOPE — imports and override/architecture correctness ONLY. Other agents own tokens/CSS, TypeScript, tests, AC conformance.

READ FIRST, in full:
- .claude/rules/overrideStyling.md — especially "Importing an already-overridden component from a new component" and "The SFCC bridge pattern"
- .claude/rules/conventions.md — the "Imports" section
- .claude/rules/components.md — "Composition" (container/presentational separation)
- .docs/memory/sprintScope.md if it exists

AUDIT every .ts/.tsx in `git diff origin/develop --name-only` under overrides/, plus .storybook/preview.tsx.

Check:
1. **THE BIG ONE — base-path import of an already-overridden component.** If file A imports `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/B` and `overrides/app/components/B/` ALSO exists, then the real app build resolves to the override but Storybook (`.storybook/main.js` aliases the package straight to node_modules) and Vitest (no alias at all) resolve to BASE. The story/test then silently exercises the wrong component. For every base-path import, `ls` the corresponding overrides path and report every hit. A base-path import with NO local override is CORRECT — do not flag it.
2. **Circular imports** — one level deep is sufficient; verify mechanically across the overrides/ graph.
3. **No imports from internal node_modules/@salesforce/... source paths** (published entrypoints only).
4. **Container/presentational separation** — nothing under overrides/app/components/ may call data-fetching hooks (@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react, React Query). Note: useMultiSite and useHistory are NOT data-fetching.
5. **No `../../../..` chains longer than 3 levels.**
6. **No imports from a later-sprint feature** (cross-check .docs/memory/sprintScope.md).
7. **Bridge pattern** — for any component overridden here, grep whether SFCC's own base components import it: `grep -r "from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/<name>'" node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/`. Any hits ⇒ the default export must stay a faithful undecorated port, with brand styling behind a named export. Verify for every component this branch overrides.
8. **The four path-alias configs must agree** — babel.config.js, tsconfig.json, .storybook/main.js, vitest.config.ts. Confirm `app` and `~` resolve identically in all four; a mismatch silently breaks one environment only.

ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS:
- Run `git diff origin/develop -- <file>` before flagging; label PRE-EXISTING when the import line is not newly added. `overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx`'s whole diff is 14 comment lines — anything else in it is inherited.
- KNOWN AND ALREADY TRIAGED, report only if your analysis changes the conclusion: (a) header/index.tsx imports chevrons from the base icons path while overrides/app/components/icons/ exists and this branch made them diverge — currently dormant because header has no story and no test; (b) footer/index.tsx imports HOME_HREF from the base constants path while overrides/app/constants/ exists, which is purely additive today.
- Verify the override directory EXISTS with `ls` before reporting check 1. Do not infer from naming.
- Do not report a proxy as a finding.

OUTPUT: findings classified MUST-FIX / SHOULD-FIX / BACKLOG with file:line, plus an explicit "verified clean" section. Read-only — do not modify files.

4	Cross-references [overrides.md](./overrides.md) (module-replacement correctness — a
5	different concern: that file is about not breaking SFCC's own imports, this one is
6	about what values to reach for once the component compiles). Day-to-day CSS/token
7	rules live in [css.md](./css.md); this file is the practical "what do I actually type"
8	companion.
9	
10	---
11	
12	## The hierarchy — reach for these in order
13	
14	1. **`textStyle` prop** for anything textual. `textStyle="body2"`, never a raw `fontSize`.
15	   All 22 Handover text styles are registered in `theme/foundation/typography.ts`.
16	2. **Semantic colour/spacing token strings** — `color="text.default"`, `bg="background.02"`,
17	   `spacing="m"`, `padding={{ base: 'm', md: 'xl' }}`. These resolve through
18	   `theme.colors`/`theme.space` (both registered — see `theme/index.ts`'s own comment
19	   for which foundation scales are and aren't registered, and why).
20	3. **A component's own theme config** (`theme/components/<name>.ts`) for anything that
21	   needs to vary by variant/size/state and isn't already a Chakra prop — see
22	   "Component-local tokens" below. For an interactive component with existing Chakra
23	   support (buttons, inputs, etc.), this theme config is the single source of truth —
24	   see "One canonical styling surface per component type" below.
25	4. **`sx` prop** for a one-off Chakra-prop-system gap, per [css.md](./css.md).
26	5. **Scoped `.scss`** only when `sx` genuinely can't express it (complex pseudo-selectors,
27	   keyframes) — same file, same rules as [css.md](./css.md) already documents.
28	
29	**Never**: a raw hex/px/rem/em literal in a component file — reach for the token
30	instead. The one standing exception is `button.ts`'s provisional height/padding
31	constants (`BTN_HEIGHT_LG`/`BTN_HEIGHT_SM`/`BTN_PADDING_Y`), pending UI-designer
32	sign-off — see Units below. Run `node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` before opening
33	a PR that touches `overrides/app/components/**` or `overrides/app/theme/components/**`
34	— it greps for exactly this. It is not wired into CI yet — that's a reasonable next
35	step once someone owns triaging its false positives (hairline px is expected and
36	not a bug; see below).
37	
38	## Units
39	
40	- **`rem`** for anything that should scale with the user's root font-size / browser zoom
41	  (WCAG 1.4.4): type (`fontSize`, `lineHeight`, `letterSpacing`) and spacing
42	  (`spacing.ts`'s named scale). Letter-spacing values that were specified as sub-pixel px
43	  in the source don't round to clean rem numbers, so those keep a trailing `// -0.12px`
44	  comment for traceability.
45	- **`px`** for hairline geometry that should _not_ scale: border widths, focus-ring
46	  offsets, and (for now) the provisional button-height constants in `button.ts` that are
47	  still pending UI-designer sign-off against Handover.
48	- **`em`** only for breakpoints (`gridSystem.ts` — deliberate, so `.zimm-grid`'s media
49	  queries shift with zoom the same way Chakra's responsive props do) and other
50	  genuinely context-relative cases. Not a general-purpose unit.
51	
52	## The alias tier is a reference, not a second copy
53	
54	`theme/foundation/colour.ts`'s primitive tier (`grey`, `ivory`, ...) is defined first as
55	plain `const`s, and the semantic/alias tier below it (`text`, `background`, `border`,
56	...) reads from those consts (`text.default: grey[900]`) instead of retyping the hex
57	value. Do the same for any new primitive/alias pair you add — two values can't disagree
58	if only one of them is ever typed.
59	
60	`zimmTokens.ts` (the `--zimm-*` CSS-var registry for `globalStyles.ts`'s `.zimm-*`
61	classes) is fully derived the same way — it imports `colors`/`spacing`/`fontSizes`/
62	`lineHeights`/`letterSpacings`/`fontWeights`/`iconSizes`/`actionSizes`/`motion`/`grid`
63	from their owning files rather than retyping values. The only literals left are the 7
64	numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases with no named-scale equivalent (`025`, `700`, `1100`,
65	`1200`, `1300`, `3500`, `4500`) — not duplicates, just Handover values with nothing to
66	derive them from. `theme/index.test.tsx`'s collision-guard tests still exist as a
67	regression net; treat a failure there as a real drift signal, not test noise.
68	
69	## One canonical styling surface per component type
70	
71	Only one place should define how a given interactive component looks: its
72	`theme/components/<name>.ts` config, consumed via Chakra's component (`<Button>`,
73	`<Link>` variant, etc.). Don't also give it a `.zimm-*` global class in
74	`globalStyles.ts` — a static CSS class can't express `_hover`/`_active`/`_disabled`/
75	`_focusVisible` states the way a Chakra theme config can, so a class "mirror" is
76	structurally incomplete from the start, and nothing stops its values from disagreeing
77	with the real theme config over time. `button.ts` is the single source of truth for
78	button styling; `globalStyles.ts` has no `.zimm-btn-*` classes — use Chakra's `<Button>`
79	for any button, not a class.
80	
81	`.zimm-*` classes remain the right tool for genuinely static, non-interactive,
82	massively-reused treatments (typography, the responsive grid, form-field layout) where
83	there's no interactive state to lose.
84	
85	## Importing an already-overridden component from a new component
86	
87	If component A (e.g. `productDetailOptions`) uses component B, and B already has an
88	override (e.g. `swatch-group`), **import B via a relative path
89	(`'../swatch-group'`), not the SFCC base path
90	(`'@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/swatch-group'`)** — even though the
91	base path is exactly what [overrides.md](./overrides.md) requires _inside_ an override
92	that's itself shadowing an SFCC module (see `product-tile/index.tsx`'s `DisplayPrice`
93	import, which is correct for that file).
94	
95	The reason the two cases differ: the resolver that redirects
96	`@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` imports to `overrides/` (`ccExtensibility` in
97	`package.json`, read by a webpack plugin) only runs in the **real app build** — dev
98	server and production. `.storybook/main.js` aliases that package straight to
99	`node_modules` and `vitest.config.ts` doesn't touch it at all, so neither loads the
100	resolver. A base-path import of an already-overridden component will build and run
101	correctly in the shipped app, but silently render/test the **unstyled base SFCC
102	version** in Storybook and Vitest — the story or test looks like it's exercising your
103	override and isn't.
104	
105	**Known instance of this, not yet fixed:** `product-tile/index.tsx`'s `DisplayPrice`
106	import uses the base path. Currently dormant only because its Storybook story exercises
107	the `CardBaseline` named export (which takes `price` as a pre-rendered node and never
108	calls `DisplayPrice`), not the default `ProductTile` bridge that actually renders it —
109	worth fixing before anything writes a story/test against the default export.
110	
111	An override component's own base-path imports (of modules it is _not_ also
112	overriding) are unaffected by this — `RecommendedProducts`, `Seo`, `QuantityPicker`
113	etc. have no local override to miss, so the base path is simply correct for them.
114	
115	## Component-local tokens
116	
117	When a component needs a spacing/sizing value that already has a `spacing.ts` /
118	`iconSizes` / etc. entry, reference it **by name** in the theme config
119	(`marginBottom: 'xs'`, not `marginBottom: 2` or `marginBottom: '0.5rem'`) — Chakra
120	resolves named scale keys against the registered `theme.space` automatically. See
121	`theme/components/imageGallery.ts` / `swatchGroup.ts` for the pattern: both re-express
122	values the base SFCC theme already had as anonymous Chakra numerics (`marginBottom: 2`)
123	using our named scale instead, at the same responsive steps (`['2xs', '2xs', 'xs',
124	'xs']` instead of `[1, 1, 2, 2]`) — same computed output, now traceable to a brand
125	token.
126	
127	When a component needs a dimension with **no existing foundation entry** (and you don't
128	have a confirmed Figma value for it), leave it inherited from the base SFCC theme rather
129	than inventing a number — don't guess at design values. Follow the precedent already in
130	`header.ts`/`button.ts`: if you do have to ship a placeholder value pending designer
131	sign-off, say so in a comment next to it, the same way those files already do.
132	
133	## The SFCC bridge pattern (shared components only)
134	
135	If the component is used internally by SFCC's own base components (check with `grep -r
136	"from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/<name>'"
137	node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/`), its **default export must stay a
138	faithful, undecorated port** — full original prop surface, same `forwardRef` behaviour,
139	matching what [overrides.md](./overrides.md) already requires for correctness. Put
140	Zimmermann-only styling behind a **named export** that wraps the default and adds
141	brand-specific defaults, the same split `product-tile/index.tsx` (`CardBaseline`
142	name + default) and `link/index.tsx` already use. `image-gallery`, `display-price`, and
143	`swatch-group` are all shared internal SFCC dependencies — their default exports are
144	kept API-compatible; brand styling for them lives in their `theme/components/*.ts`
145	config instead of a named-export split, since token-driven theming doesn't require a
146	second export the way `CardBaseline`'s prop-narrowing did.
147	
148	---
149	
150	## Known gaps (not silently dropped — logged here)
151	
152	- The f2r `zimm-product-detail-options` prototype spec includes a size-as-dropdown
153	  picker, a wishlist button, a "find in boutique" link, and description/shipping
154	  accordions. None of those exist as overrides yet, so `ProductDetailOptions` ships
155	  without them — it's colour/size swatches, quantity, and add-to-bag only.
156	- `swatch-group`'s `square`/`circle` variant functions (selected/disabled colour logic,
157	  the diagonal disabled-state gradient) are still inherited from the base SFCC theme —
158	  real visual design decisions with no Zimmermann Figma spec behind them yet.
159	- `button.ts`'s `BTN_HEIGHT_LG`/`BTN_HEIGHT_SM` (50px/41px) disagree with the
160	  Handover-sourced `actionSizes.height.lg`/`.md` (52px/40px) — flagged in `button.ts`,
161	  pending UI-designer sign-off. `BTN_PADDING_Y` (5px) has no Handover token at all —
162	  a gap to fill, not a conflict to resolve.
163	- `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/` is claimed by `.claude/rules/squadA.md`
164	  (draft, scope still settling) — flagged for awareness, not treated as a hard block.
165	
166	## Follow-up work (separate initiatives)
167	
168	- **Per-component CSS loading.** `globalStyles.ts`'s `.zimm-*` class registry is
169	  registered as one `theme.styles.global` block and ships on every page regardless of
170	  which classes a given page's components actually use. If component overrides start
171	  applying `.zimm-*` classNames directly for the non-interactive cases described above,
172	  only the classes a page's components actually reference should load, not the whole
173	  registry. Needs its own investigation, not scoped or estimated yet.
174	- **`globalStyles.ts` adoption is currently near zero.** Of the classes still defined
175	  there, none have a real consumer anywhere in the app today except one Storybook demo
176	  (`spacing.stories.tsx`'s `.zimm-grid` example). They're Handover-ported 1:1 and
177	  presumably _intended_ to be reused, just not adopted by any component yet — worth
178	  revisiting once component overrides actually start applying them.

(`marginBottom: 'xs'`, not `marginBottom: 2` or `marginBottom: '0.5rem'`) — Chakra
resolves named scale keys against the registered `theme.space` automatically. See
`theme/components/imageGallery.ts` / `swatchGroup.ts` for the pattern: both re-express
values the base SFCC theme already had as anonymous Chakra numerics (`marginBottom: 2`)
using our named scale instead, at the same responsive steps (`['2xs', '2xs', 'xs',
'xs']` instead of `[1, 1, 2, 2]`) — same computed output, now traceable to a brand
token.

When a component needs a dimension with **no existing foundation entry** (and you don't
have a confirmed Figma value for it), leave it inherited from the base SFCC theme rather
than inventing a number — don't guess at design values. Follow the precedent already in
`header.ts`/`button.ts`: if you do have to ship a placeholder value pending designer
sign-off, say so in a comment next to it, the same way those files already do.

## The SFCC bridge pattern (shared components only)

If the component is used internally by SFCC's own base components (check with `grep -r
"from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/<name>'"
node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/`), its **default export must stay a
faithful, undecorated port** — full original prop surface, same `forwardRef` behaviour,
matching what [overrides.md](./overrides.md) already requires for correctness. Put
Zimmermann-only styling behind a **named export** that wraps the default and adds
brand-specific defaults, the same split `product-tile/index.tsx` (`CardBaseline`
name + default) and `link/index.tsx` already use. `image-gallery`, `display-price`, and
`swatch-group` are all shared internal SFCC dependencies — their default exports are
kept API-compatible; brand styling for them lives in their `theme/components/*.ts`
config instead of a named-export split, since token-driven theming doesn't require a
second export the way `CardBaseline`'s prop-narrowing did.

---

## Known gaps (not silently dropped — logged here)

- The f2r `zimm-product-detail-options` prototype spec includes a size-as-dropdown
  picker, a wishlist button, a "find in boutique" link, and description/shipping
  accordions. None of those exist as overrides yet, so `ProductDetailOptions` ships
  without them — it's colour/size swatches, quantity, and add-to-bag only.
- `swatch-group`'s `square`/`circle` variant functions (selected/disabled colour logic,
  the diagonal disabled-state gradient) are still inherited from the base SFCC theme —
  real visual design decisions with no Zimmermann Figma spec behind them yet.
- `button.ts`'s `BTN_HEIGHT_LG`/`BTN_HEIGHT_SM` (50px/41px) disagree with the
  Handover-sourced `actionSizes.height.lg`/`.md` (52px/40px) — flagged in `button.ts`,
  pending UI-designer sign-off. `BTN_PADDING_Y` (5px) has no Handover token at all —
  a gap to fill, not a conflict to resolve.
- `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/` is claimed by `.claude/rules/squadA.md`
  (draft, scope still settling) — flagged for awareness, not treated as a hard block.

## Follow-up work (separate initiatives)

- **Per-component CSS loading.** `globalStyles.ts`'s `.zimm-*` class registry is
  registered as one `theme.styles.global` block and ships on every page regardless of
  which classes a given page's components actually use. If component overrides start
  applying `.zimm-*` classNames directly for the non-interactive cases described above,
  only the classes a page's components actually reference should load, not the whole
  registry. Needs its own investigation, not scoped or estimated yet.
- **`globalStyles.ts` adoption is currently near zero.** Of the classes still defined
  there, none have a real consumer anywhere in the app today except one Storybook demo
  (`spacing.stories.tsx`'s `.zimm-grid` example). They're Handover-ported 1:1 and
  presumably _intended_ to be reused, just not adopted by any component yet — worth
  revisiting once component overrides actually start applying them.

import React from 'react';
import type { Preview, Decorator } from '@storybook/react-webpack5';
import { ChakraProvider } from '@chakra-ui/react';
import { IntlProvider } from 'react-intl';
import theme from '../overrides/app/theme';
import { ZimmTokensGlobal } from '../overrides/app/theme/zimmTokensGlobal';
import { ZimmFontFace } from '../overrides/app/theme/fontFace';

// ZimmTokensGlobal injects the --zimm-* :root custom properties, mirroring what
// _app-config does in the app. Without it, the .zimm-* global classes and the
// var(--zimm-*) component overrides (button/header/listMenu) render unresolved in
// Storybook. Same shared source as the app, so the two cannot drift.
//
// ZimmFontFace declares the self-hosted Futura Round faces, likewise mirroring
// _app-config. Without it Storybook renders the fallback stack while the app renders
// Futura Round — the fallback measures ~13% wider, so any visual comparison made in
// Storybook would not match the app or Figma. Font files are served here by the
// staticDirs mapping in .storybook/main.js.
const withChakra: Decorator = (Story) => (
  <ChakraProvider theme={theme}>
    <ZimmFontFace />
    <ZimmTokensGlobal />
    <Story />
  </ChakraProvider>
);

const withIntl: Decorator = (Story) => (
  <IntlProvider locale="en-AU" defaultLocale="en-AU">
    <Story />
  </IntlProvider>
);

const preview: Preview = {
  parameters: {
    controls: {
      matchers: {
        color: /(background|color)$/i,
        date: /date$/i,
      },
    },
    layout: 'centered',
    a11y: {
      // 'error' causes a11y violations to fail test-storybook --ci runs
      test: 'error',
      // Chakra UI injects toast region containers (role="region") at the root
      // without an accessible name — a known upstream limitation. Exclude them
      // from all a11y checks since they are framework-level, not component output.
      context: {
        exclude: [
          '#chakra-toast-manager-top',
          '#chakra-toast-manager-top-right',
          '#chakra-toast-manager-top-left',
          '#chakra-toast-manager-bottom',
          '#chakra-toast-manager-bottom-right',
          '#chakra-toast-manager-bottom-left',
        ],
      },
    },
  },
  decorators: [withChakra, withIntl],
};

export default preview;

content.text:
Audit complete. All eight checks run mechanically across the 36 changed `.ts/.tsx` files under `overrides/` plus `.storybook/preview.tsx`.

## MUST-FIX

None. No base-path import of an already-overridden component was introduced by this branch, no cycles, no internal-`node_modules` imports, no deep relative chains, no later-sprint references, and the four alias configs agree.

## SHOULD-FIX

**1. `overrides/app/components/footer/index.stories.tsx:2` — imports from an undeclared, transitive-only package.**
```ts
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react';
```
`@storybook/react` is **not** in `package.json` (verified: `grep '"@storybook/react"' package.json` → absent; `npm ls` → present only as a child of `@storybook/react-webpack5@10.4.6`). Every one of the other 19 stories in the repo — including the six ui-kit stories added on this branch — uses `@storybook/react-webpack5`, which *is* a declared devDependency. It works today purely on npm hoisting. Type-only, so nothing breaks now; fix is a one-word edit, no package change (so no Hard Rule #7 exposure).

**2. `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx` — bridge pattern is inverted.**
`components/footer` **is** a shared internal SFCC dependency: `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/_app/index.jsx:43,484` imports it and renders `<Footer />`. overrideStyling.md's "SFCC bridge pattern" requires the *default* export to be the faithful undecorated port with brand behaviour behind a *named* export. Here it's the reverse — default is the decorated `FooterContainer` (line 549, exported line 560, injects `FOOTER_FIXTURE` + `onLogoClick`); the undecorated presentational port is the named `Footer` (line 416).

Runtime impact is zero (the sole SFCC consumer passes no props; all container props are optional), and lines 538–548 document the reasoning — SFCC renders `<Footer />` with no props, so a faithful undecorated default would render an empty footer. Two concrete deltas from base: base is `const Footer = ({...otherProps})` spreading arbitrary props onto its root; the override's default takes only `Omit<FooterProps, 'data'>` and drops that passthrough. Either restore the passthrough, or record the inversion as an accepted exception in overrideStyling.md — otherwise the next reviewer "fixes" it backwards.

## BACKLOG

**3. Chevron divergence blast radius is 15 base files, not just header** — this refines triaged item (a). `zimm.tsx` gained `ChevronDown/Left/Right/UpIcon` (24×24 stroked) and `icons/index.tsx` dropped the four base re-exports, so the override now genuinely diverges from base where it previously didn't. The real app build resolves `app/components/icons` to the override for **62** SFCC base modules, **15** of which consume a chevron: `basic-tile`, `breadcrumb`, `header`, `list-menu-trigger`, `locale-selector`, `nested-accordion`, `pagination`, `product-scroller`, `promo-code`, `search/partials/ask-assistant-banner`, `page-designer/layouts/carousel`, `pages/account/{index,order-detail,order-history}`, `pages/product-list`. Correct and intended in the app; the Storybook/Vitest split is dormant only because none of those 15 has an override, story, or test here yet. `header/index.tsx:51` (PRE-EXISTING, this branch's whole header diff is 14 comment lines) is the same class — switch it to `app/components/icons` when header is next touched.

**4. `FigmaLogo` / `GithubLogo`** are the only base icon exports the override drops (PRE-EXISTING). Consumed solely by base `app/pages/home/data.js`, and `overrides/app/pages/home/` already exists — harmless, but they'd be `undefined` if base home data is ever rendered.

**5. `overrides/app/components/footer/index.tsx:545-548`** self-flags that HPC-034 will put a Contentful fetch inside `overrides/app/components/`, which components.md reserves for containers, and proposes overriding `_app` instead (Tier 2 shell). Decide before HPC-034 starts.

**6. `overrides/app/components/footer/contentfulSchema.placeholder.ts`** is imported by nothing (only named in a comment at `overrides/app/types/contentful.ts:81`). protectedFiles.md puts real content-type definitions in `scripts/contentful/content-types/` (Tier 2, Integration-owned) — that's where it belongs at HPC-034.

**Out of scope, flagging once since no agent in the split appears to own it:** `.storybook/main.js` and `.storybook/preview.tsx` are both modified on this branch, and `.storybook/` is Tier 1 (frozenFiles.md; AGENTS.md Hard Rule #8).

## Verified clean

- **Check 1.** Every base-path import in the changed files was `ls`-verified against `overrides/app/`. Four live collisions, all benign:
  - `constants` × 3 (`footer/index.tsx:15` HOME_HREF, `_app-config/index.tsx:44`, `header/index.tsx:59` — the latter two PRE-EXISTING). **`overrides/app/constants/index.ts:17` is `export * from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/constants'`**, so every base constant is re-exported byte-identically; the only delta is the additive `CUSTOM_HOME_TITLE`. Zero divergence in any of the three resolution environments. Confirms triaged item (b) — no new finding.
  - `header/index.tsx:51` → `components/icons` = triaged item (a), refined in BACKLOG 3 above.
- **Not findings** (verified, so a reviewer doesn't re-flag them): self-shadow "extend the base" imports at `icons/index.tsx:73`, `constants/index.ts:15,17`, `theme/index.ts:15`, `routes.tsx:15`; `types/vendor.d.ts:11` is a `declare module`, not an import; `footer/index.tsx:540` is a doc comment.
- **The branch's compliance pattern.** All 15 cross-folder override imports use the `app/...` alias, not base paths — including `zimmIcon/index.tsx:41 → app/components/icons`, which resolves to the **override** in all four environments. The alias is the exact equivalent of overrideStyling.md's relative-path rule and additionally satisfies check 5. Do not "fix" these to base paths. All 54 local imports in the changed files resolve; zero unresolved.
- **Check 2.** Zero circular imports — both 1-level pair detection and full-DFS any-length, across all 94 `.ts/.tsx` in `overrides/`.
- **Check 3.** Clean. Sole `node_modules` string in `overrides/` is a comment at `theme/components/header.ts:3`. No `dist/`/`src/` subpath imports.
- **Check 4.** No data-fetching hook in any component added by this branch. Footer's `useMultiSite`/`useHistory` live in `FooterContainer`, not the presentational `Footer` — which is exactly why `index.stories.tsx` can mount `Footer` with no providers. `_app-config`'s `CommerceApiProvider`/`ReactQueryDevtools` are provider wiring (its job); its diff is +1 import, +1 render. *Pre-existing, outside this diff:* `contentful/productHero.tsx:4` and `contentful/experiences/hotspotPopup.tsx:3` call `useProduct` inside `components/` — for whoever owns Contentful, not this branch.
- **Check 5.** Zero 4+ level chains anywhere in `overrides/`. Two 3-level (both pre-existing, within limit).
- **Check 6.** Zero later-sprint references; no `fetch`/`axios`/`createClient` in `footer/index.tsx` or `useSubscribeModal.ts`.
- **Check 7.** Icons barrel has **no silent shadowing**: `zimm.tsx`'s 25 exports and the 55 explicit base re-exports are fully disjoint (80 total, no dedup), so the `export *`-then-explicit ordering is safe and every base-consumed name except `FigmaLogo`/`GithubLogo` still resolves. Theme keys don't collide: override footer uses its own `ZimmFooter` recipe (`ZIMM_FOOTER_RECIPE`, 5 call sites), leaving base `Footer` and `CheckoutFooter` untouched; `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` shadows nothing (base has no `theme/components/index.js` — only `base/` and `project/` subdirs).
- **Check 8.** `~` → repo root and `app` → `overrides/app` in all four: `babel.config.js:20-23`, `tsconfig.json` `paths`, `.storybook/main.js` `webpackFinal`, `vitest.config.ts` `resolve.alias`. Also confirmed the intended asymmetry that check 1 exists to police: none of the four aliases `@salesforce/retail-react-app` to `overrides/`; only Storybook aliases it, straight to `node_modules`.
- **`.storybook/preview.tsx`.** `ChakraProvider` from `@chakra-ui/react` is equivalent to the app's `shared/ui` import (that barrel is a plain re-export of Chakra, `ChakraProvider` included); `theme` via relative path resolves to the override. No app↔Storybook divergence.
